title: Building a Learning AI Customer Service: Encore AI Secures $30 Million in Series A Funding to Monetize Enterprise Conversation Data

content_html:
Recently, the artificial intelligence startup Encore AI announced a $30 million Series A funding round, led by Team8, with participation from Planven, Lukatz, and several banks and insurance institutions. The company focuses on training and deploying intelligent voice agents that can work independently or assist teams by analyzing daily conversations between companies and their customers.

The company was initially founded in 2022 by CEO Dvir Ginzburg, primarily providing recommendation software for financial advisors. Today, the brand has been rebranded as Encore AI, with its core business focused on analyzing call recordings, emails, and texts between employees and customers to identify key communication paths that lead to business success. Ginzburg refers to this process as "interaction mining," and its platform connects large volumes of customer service data with CRM systems to extract effective response strategies and scripts used by top-performing employees.

Currently, the platform can interact directly with customers through voice or text and provide real-time suggestions to employees during the conversation. According to official information, the company currently has more than 40 global enterprise customers, mostly financial institutions, and its annual recurring revenue has grown more than five times in less than 18 months.

Facing potential competitive pressure from large CRM giants like Salesforce and SAP, Ginzburg pointed out that merely having data is not enough. Traditional vendors looking to use historical conversations as the foundation for intelligent agents must completely restructure their technology stack. According to reports, this round of funding will be used to expand sales operations in the U.S. market and promote the platform's deployment in more large financial institutions.

content_html_zh:
近日，人工智能初创公司Encore AI宣布完成3000万美元A轮融资，由Team8领投，Planven、Lukatz以及多家银行和保险机构跟投。 该公司专注于培训和部署智能语音代理，这些代理可以独立工作或通过分析公司与其客户之间的日常对话来协助团队。

该公司最初由首席执行官 Dvir Ginzburg 于 2022 年创立，主要为财务顾问提供推荐软件。 如今，该品牌已更名为 Encore AI，其核心业务专注于分析员工与客户之间的通话录音、电子邮件和文本，以确定导致业务成功的关键沟通路径。 Ginzburg 将这一过程称为“交互挖掘”，其平台将大量客户服务数据与 CRM 系统连接起来，以提取表现最佳的员工使用的有效响应策略和脚本。

目前，该平台可以通过语音或文字直接与客户互动，并在对话过程中向员工提供实时建议。 官方资料显示，该公司目前拥有40多家全球企业客户，其中大部分是金融机构，其年度经常性收入在不到18个月的时间里增长了五倍以上。

面对Salesforce、SAP等大型CRM巨头的潜在竞争压力，Ginzburg指出，仅仅拥有数据是不够的。 希望使用历史对话作为智能代理基础的传统供应商必须彻底重组其技术堆栈。 据介绍，本轮融资将用于扩大美国市场的销售业务，并推动该平台在更多大型金融机构的部署。
